disclaimer: Demographic labels are simulated based on epidemiological literature due to absence of clinical metadata in this public dataset. Results demonstrate the fairness audit methodology, not real-world disparities.

novel_finding.description: High-uncertainty predictions (top 20%) are disproportionately concentrated in the 61+ age group (36.9% of uncertain vs 26.3% of total) and Female patients (59.1% vs 53.2%), suggesting MC Dropout uncertainty is a proxy for demographic underrepresentation.
